brief: My courtyard is partial shade with low moisture, and one dog lives in the household. A shaded inner courtyard with very free-draining soil and a husky that digs up every root.

design.site_summary: A partially shaded balcony microclimate with low moisture needs, designed for a curious cat who loves to graze safely.
design.layout_strategy: Trailing succulents on the upper railing at eye level, upright perennial herbs at mid height against the back wall, and low grazing succulents along the easily accessible floor edge.
design.combination_logic: The combination contrasts the fine, cascading texture of Sedum morganianum with the architectural rosette forms of Echeveria elegans and the aromatic foliage of Salvia officinalis. Throughout the year, evergreen foliage provides steady color while Alyssum spp. introduces seasonal floral accents, creating visual variety in height, color, and texture.

zones.placement: on the east-facing railing, 3 h of morning sun, sheltered from afternoon heat

plants.why: Provides a lush trailing habit suitable for hanging containers above floor level.
plants.role_in_combination: Contributes a cascading texture that softens the hard edges of the railing.

maintenance: Water every 10 to 14 days when soil is completely dry
Prune stray stems lightly in spring

zones.placement: against the back wall, receiving bright indirect light and 2 hours of morning sun

plants.why: Adds vertical height and pleasant aroma at mid-container level.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides a contrasting grey-green leaf colour and woody stems that anchor the mid-level composition.

plants.why: Fills gaps with low-growing flowering habit in partial shade.
plants.role_in_combination: Introduces delicate seasonal flowers and sweet fragrance to complement the sage.

maintenance: Water weekly during active summer growth and every three weeks in winter
Trim back spent flower heads after blooming

zones.placement: on the accessible balcony floor in a bright indirect light zone where the cat rests

plants.why: Completely non-toxic, touch-safe, and low-growing for direct pet interaction.
plants.role_in_combination: Offers sculptural rosette symmetry at ground level that contrasts with trailing and upright elements.

plants.why: Safe for chewing and robust enough for ground-level placement.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds striking striped patterns and tactile variety within the ground layer.

maintenance: Water every 14 days when the soil dries out completely
Inspect leaves monthly for any signs of wear from grazing

care_instructions.task: Check soil moisture in all containers by inserting a finger 2 inches deep
Water all containers thoroughly until drainage occurs at the base
Reduce watering frequency for succulent and herb zones to prevent root rot
Fertilize containers with a balanced organic plant food

care_cautions: Overwatering Sedum morganianum and Echeveria elegans in the hanging baskets and ground pots can lead to root rot.
Tender perennials like Salvia officinalis may suffer frost damage if left unprotected during freezing winter nights.
design.pet_safety_note: Every plant selected is completely non-toxic to cats and dogs, and the grazing zone is positioned directly on the floor for safe, independent access.
